text.tspan: What happens when a pod starts (and the status you see if a step fails)
Pod saved: Pending, no node yet
watches, sees a pod assigned to it
✗ Pending: Insufficient cpu · taint · PVC zone
On the node: kubelet drives containerd (CRI) and the CNI plugin
one by one, each must exit 0
Pod IP comes at step 3, before your app starts. kubelet reports status at every step: Pending → ContainerCreating → Running.
First command for any red box: kubectl describe pod <name> → read Events at the bottom.
